full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case are that on 5.2.82 first party opposite party Md. Nurul Alam filed a petition before the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Patiya, Chittagong stating that his mother Sarnuda Khatun possessed 2.76 acres of land out of 7.28 acres by way of inheritance from her father late Abdul Majid. First Party opposite party Nurul Alam claimed possession of her mother by way of partition. It was also stated in the petition by first party Nurul Alam that Second Party men Abu Sadek, Abul Basher, Abu Naser and Abdul Mannan (why are sons of his mother's brother late Abul Fazal) are threatening to cut and take way the crops grown on the disputed land; that they are also trying to forcibly take over possession of the disputed land; that there is serious apprehension of breach of peace and loss of life .over the possession of the disputed land and that the second party men should be restrained by an order under section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The learned Sub-Divisional Magistrate on 6.2.82 asked the Officer-in charge Anwara Police Station to enquire and report. The Officer-in-charge of Anwara Police Station reported that the plots noted in the petition are situated in Mouza Sarenga and Khuruskhul of Anwara Police Station; that both the parties claimed possession over the land, that both parties are men of power in the locality that the land is in possession of the petitioners. that the second party men are trying to oust the petitioner by using force and violence and that there is every chance of serious breach of peace with loss of lives etc. and proceeding under section 145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure should be drawn appointing Circle Officer (Rev.), Anwara, Chittagong as Receiver and restraining both the parties from entering into the disputed land.
